statuses.ok: every governing attribute evaluable and disparity <= 0.04

statuses.ok: 95% interval for the gap lies wholly at or below the limit
statuses.halt: 95% interval lies wholly above the limit: suspend flagging, notify Ethics Committee
statuses.inconclusive: interval straddles the limit: no conclusion; review at monthly audit, extend window
statuses.insufficient data: fewer than 2 groups meet the minimum counts: no fairness conclusion is drawn
